reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount from #shared/schedules, the same helper forecast, schedule app and templates already use.

duplication.why: No range/null logic is re-written; the one-line mapping delegates entirely to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal where API shaping lives, but it is declared as a required member of APIScheduleEntity, a type also used as the create/update input.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean and small; the only wart is that an output-only derived field now becomes required on the create-schedule input type (Omit<APIScheduleEntity,'id'>) and visible to the update key loop.
